products.short_description: The correct, repeatable way to deliver secure, reliable mobile access to SharePoint Online under MAM — App Protection Policies + Conditional Access + the right access path (SharePoint app vs. protected browser) + the intranet-routing decision, with a root-cause diagnostic tree. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Make SharePoint Online reliably reachable on mobile under MAM — without breaking data protection

A SharePoint Online intranet that works fine on a laptop can be a mess on mobile the moment Mobile Application Management (MAM) is in play: employees get blocked or bounced, links open in the wrong app, and productivity stalls. The cause is almost always a mismatch between App Protection Policies, Conditional Access, and the access path the user actually takes (the SharePoint mobile app vs. a protected browser) — and sometimes an intranet-routing gap. This solution gives you the correct, repeatable way to deliver secure, reliable mobile access to SharePoint Online under MAM in Microsoft Intune, and a diagnostic path to root-cause when it isn't working.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — how mobile access to SharePoint Online works under MAM, the interplay of App Protection Policies + Conditional Access, the supported access paths (the SharePoint mobile app vs. a MAM-protected browser like Edge), and when intranet routing / Microsoft Tunnel for MAM is required.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Intune with App Protection, Entra ID + Conditional Access, the Microsoft 365 apps in scope, licensing, target user groups, a pilot group) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.
  • Implementation Guide (the resolution) — exact, ordered steps: define the App Protection Policies, build the Conditional Access policy (approved client apps / app-protection grant), confirm the supported access path and steer users to it, decide and (if needed) wire intranet routing / Tunnel for MAM, validate mobile access end to end, then pilot and expand.
  • Root-cause diagnostic tree — a step-by-step method for 'can't access the intranet on mobile': CA block vs. missing app-protection grant vs. wrong access path (browser vs. app) vs. routing/Tunnel gap vs. sign-in/token issues, with how to confirm each.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — App Protection + Conditional Access readiness discovery, per-user mobile-access validation, an access + policy-coverage report, safe remediation of misconfigured assignments, and a mobile-access scope-group builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Reliable, protected mobile access to a SharePoint Online intranet under MAM — App Protection and Conditional Access aligned, users on the supported access path, and intranet routing handled — with a diagnostic tree to root-cause any failure, proven on a pilot before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • SPMAM-Discovery.ps1 — inventory App Protection Policies + Conditional Access policies for
    • SPMAM-Remediation.ps1 — safely fix a common misconfiguration: assign the App Protection Policies
    • SPMAM-Report.ps1 — coverage report: which target users have an App Protection Policy AND are in
    • SPMAM-Set-ScopeTargeting.ps1 — build/maintain the SharePoint Online mobile-access scope groups
    • SPMAM-Validation.ps1 — per-user check that App Protection is applied AND the CA app-protection

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
